dct_description_sm: Two Ice Mass Balance buoys were deployed on the multiyear landfast sea ice over the Wandel Sea Shelf in Northeast Greenland, with co-located ice tethered moorings. Together the IMBs and moorings will sample for one year and collect a high resolution dataset on the annual cycle of sea ice growth and melt processes, and the influence of the underlying water column on these processes. These observations are the first of their kind in this area, which is unique because the multiyear sea ice we are sampling has remained landfast and not melted out in over 10 years. The study area is also of interest because there are two large outlet glaciers nearby that discharge freshwater and therefore strongly stratify the water column, potentially disrupting the vertical transfer of heat to the sea ice.
dct_title_s: Ice Mass Balance data in Northeast Greenland
